meta.name: Glass Profile UI Kit
meta.description: A dark, glassmorphic 'digital business card' / profile UI system spanning a mobile app (default + scrolled states) and a desktop portfolio dashboard. Use this file as style context for an AI code generator (e.g. Cursor) to produce new screens that feel visually consistent with the source design.
designStyle: glassmorphism (translucent panels, soft blur, subtle inner highlight)
rounded/soft geometry (large corner radii everywhere, no sharp corners)
single warm accent (amber/orange) against a cool dark navy/black base
ambient gradient glows behind content (top-left warm glow, bottom purple glow) rather than flat backgrounds
card-based composition: every logical group of content lives in its own rounded panel
high-contrast white typography on dark surfaces, generous whitespace-equivalent (dark-space) between blocks

base.bg-canvas-top: #2A1A1F  (warm dark maroon/brown radial glow, blends downward)
base.bg-canvas-bottom-accent: #2A1240  (subtle purple glow at bottom of mobile screens)

surface.surface-card-primary: rgba(30, 34, 48, 0.55)  glassmorphic navy panel, ~24-40px corner radius, faint 1px lighter top border for glass highlight
surface.surface-card-secondary: rgba(255,255,255,0.04)  even more transparent nested panel used for sub-cards (link tiles, stat pills)
surface.surface-pill-dark: #242B3D  solid-ish dark slate used behind icon glyphs (stat icons, social icons)
surface.surface-elevated-desktop-card: #131722  flatter, slightly opaque card used in desktop dashboard widgets

accent.accent-primary: #F5A623  amber/orange - avatar background, active tab underline, gradient starts, small highlight dots
accent.accent-gradient-secondary: #8B5CF6  violet - used as the second stop in gradient text/logo treatments (name wordmark on desktop)
accent.accent-gradient-usage: linear-gradient(90deg, #F5A623 0%, #A855F7 100%) - applied to hero heading text (surname) and primary CTA buttons on desktop

brand-icons.figma: multicolor logo, kept on dark chip
brand-icons.instagram: brand gradient, kept on dark chip

text.text-secondary: #9AA1B2  handles, captions, meta labels, nav item default state
text.text-on-accent: #12141C  dark text used only on the amber accent surfaces when needed

borders.glass-edge-highlight: rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 1px top/inner border to sell the glass effect

fontFamily.primary: Rounded geometric sans-serif (visually close to 'Baloo 2', 'Quicksand', or 'SF Pro Rounded'). Friendly, high x-height, soft terminals.
fontFamily.secondaryUI: Standard system sans (SF Pro / Inter) acceptable for dense desktop dashboard body copy/labels

display.usage: Desktop hero name (e.g. person's first+last name)

h2.usage: Section headers (desktop dashboard cards: 'Skills & Tools', 'Featured Projects')

caption.usage: Stat labels, meta text, tab labels

typography.notes: Numeric stat values (3.5k, 359, 620) are bold/heavy weight and visually larger than their labels; label sits directly below value, center-aligned.

spacingScale.usagePattern: Card outer padding ~24px. Gap between stacked cards ~16-20px. Gap between grid items (photos, link tiles, stat cards) ~12-16px. Section vertical rhythm on desktop ~32px.

radiusScale.radius-lg: 24px (link tiles, stat cards, sidebar nav items)
radiusScale.radius-full: 9999px (pill buttons, tab underline, avatars-as-circles when used, progress bars)
radiusScale.principle: Nothing in this system uses a sharp (0px) corner. Larger containers get proportionally larger radii; the avatar image itself uses the same large radius as its parent frame, not a circle.

elevationAndEffects.glassBlur: backdrop-filter: blur(20-30px) on all card surfaces sitting over the gradient background
elevationAndEffects.shadow-card: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)  soft, diffuse, no hard drop shadows anywhere
elevationAndEffects.shadow-avatar: 0 4px 20px rgba(245,166,35,0.25)  faint warm glow bleeding from the amber avatar frame
elevationAndEffects.gradientGlowBg: Large soft radial gradients (warm top-left, purple bottom) placed behind/under the glass cards to give the dark UI depth; never a flat single-color background
elevationAndEffects.innerHighlight: 1px semi-transparent white top border on cards to simulate light catching a glass edge

iconography.style: Filled, simple, rounded-corner square 'app icon' chips (44-56px) for brand/social icons rather than bare line icons
iconography.chipTreatment: Icon sits centered on a dark rounded-square or brand-colored rounded-square background, size ~48-64px, radius-md/lg
iconography.utilityIcons: Thin-stroke line icons (pin/location, calendar/cake, envelope, external-link arrow) used inline next to text, ~16-20px, text-secondary color
iconography.externalLinkAffordance: Small diagonal arrow-out-of-box icon top-right of any tappable link card

mobileApp.screenFrame: iOS status bar (time left, signal/wifi/battery right) + home indicator bar at bottom

state_default.description: Profile landing screen, avatar + identity + stats + content grid
order: AvatarFrame (large, square-rounded, overlapping top of the main card by ~40%)
SocialStatRow (4 icon chips, each with a numeric value below it, evenly spaced)
SegmentedTabBar (All / Photos / Music / Videos, text tabs with animated underline on active)
ContentGrid (3-column square media grid, small consistent gap, extends below/outside the glass card onto canvas)

state_scrolledDetail.description: Same profile, scrolled/expanded to show bio + structured link list instead of the stat/grid view
order: AvatarFrame (smaller/compressed on scroll, or fixed while card scrolls beneath - treat as sticky header)
BioList (2-3 lines, each prefixed with a small emoji or pin icon, left-aligned, stacked)
MetaRow (location pin + joined-date, horizontally inline, separated by generous gap, text-secondary)

LinkTileGrid (2-column grid of medium tiles: icon top-left, external-link icon top-right, label bold, value/handle below in text-secondary; brand-colored fill for primary social e.g. Facebook, dark fill for neutral entries e.g. Email)
LinkTileFullWidth (single full-width row variant for entries needing a trailing action button, e.g. GitHub with a 'Follow' pill button)
LinkTileRowCompact (smaller square icon-only tiles for remaining links, e.g. Figma / Dev.to, shown partially cropped at scroll edge to hint more content)

mobileApp.breakpoint: Single column, fixed ~390-430px design width (standard iPhone frame). No internal responsive behavior other than scroll.

desktopDashboard.description: Wider portfolio/dashboard layout reusing the same identity data in a 3-column grid
desktopDashboard.grid: 12-column grid inside a max-width shell (~1440-1536px), 3 macro-columns: fixed-width left sidebar, flexible center content, fixed-width right rail

contents: AvatarFrame (same amber rounded-square treatment) with an 'Available' status badge overlapping bottom-left
VerticalNavList (icon + label rows, active item gets a filled rounded-rect highlight in a deep violet/indigo, inactive items text-secondary)
'Let's Connect' label + row of circular/rounded social icon buttons pinned near bottom

HeroCard: greeting eyebrow text, large 2-line display name (second line in accent gradient text), role subtitle, 2-line description paragraph, primary gradient CTA button + secondary outline/ghost button, illustrative graphic anchored right (kept generic - a workstation/desk illustration)
InfoStatRow: 4 equal-width small cards in a row, each = icon chip + 2-line text (bold value / label caption)
QuickLinkRow: 4 equal-width tiles reusing the mobile link-tile component (icon, label, value, external-link glyph), same visual language as mobile LinkTileGrid

BottomRow (2 columns): 'Featured Projects' card (horizontal card carousel, each project = image thumbnail + title + tech-stack caption + external link icon, carousel dots below) sits left/wider; 'My Vibes' media-player card sits right/narrower (album art, track title/subtitle, 'Playing now' pill, queued track list, playback controls + scrub bar)

SkillsCard: header + 'View all' link, wrapped pill/chip list of skill tags (rounded-full, dark fill, tight gap), plus a labeled horizontal gradient progress/slider bar (e.g. 'Design' to 'Development' spectrum)
QuickLinksCard: compact 2-column icon+label grid (Email/Facebook/GitHub/Figma) plus 2 extra rows (Dev handle, 'Download CV' button) - denser variant of the mobile link tiles

AvatarFrame.background: Solid accent-primary (amber) fill behind a character illustration/photo
AvatarFrame.statusBadge: Small rounded-full pill, positioned overlapping the bottom-left or top-left corner of the frame, colored text/dot for state (e.g. 'Available' = success-available bg)

ProfileIdentityBlock.layout: Centered on mobile (name, then @handle directly below, both centered); left-aligned on desktop sidebar/hero
ProfileIdentityBlock.handleStyle: body, text-secondary, no @ styling beyond the character itself

StatChip.structure: Icon chip (rounded-square, brand or dark fill) stacked above a bold numeric value, stacked above a small caption label
StatChip.alignment: Center-aligned column, repeated in a horizontal row with equal gaps
StatChip.interaction: Tap opens the linked external profile/app

SegmentedTabBar.structure: Row of text labels, equal or content-based spacing, one 'active' label in text-primary + accent-primary underline bar (radius-full, ~3px thick, width = label width) beneath it; inactive labels in text-secondary with no underline
SegmentedTabBar.motion: Underline should animate/slide horizontally between tabs on change (~200-250ms ease-out)

ContentGridItem.shape: Square, radius-lg, image fill, cropped to fit
ContentGridItem.grid: 3 columns, small consistent gutter (~space-3), no card chrome/border - the image itself is the tile

BioLine.structure: Leading small icon or emoji (pin/briefcase/person) + single line of text, left-aligned, stacked with tight vertical gap (~space-2)

variants: primary-brand-fill (e.g. Facebook - solid brand color background)
neutral-dark-fill (e.g. Email, Figma - dark glass background)
full-width-with-action (e.g. GitHub - includes a trailing pill 'Follow' button)
LinkTile.structure: Icon chip top-left, external-link glyph top-right (opacity-muted), bold label mid, text-secondary value/handle below label

variants: outline-ghost (desktop secondary CTA, 1px hairline border, transparent fill)

SidebarNavItem.structure: Leading icon (20px) + label, full-width row, radius-lg

states.active: filled deep-violet/indigo background, text-primary, icon accent-colored

ProjectCard.structure: Thumbnail image (radius-lg top corners or full card), title bold, tech-stack caption text-secondary below, small external-link icon top-right of thumbnail
ProjectCard.carousel: Horizontally scrollable row with pagination dots below (active dot = accent-primary filled, inactive = muted small dot)

MediaPlayerWidget.structure: Header (title + 'View all'), large album-art thumbnail with track title/subtitle and a 'Playing now' status pill, queued-track list rows (small thumbnail + title/subtitle + duration + overflow-menu dot), transport controls (prev/play-pause/next) with a horizontal scrub/progress bar and elapsed/total time labels

SkillChip.shape: radius-full pill, dark fill, text-secondary or text-primary, tightly packed in a wrapping row

GradientMeterBar.structure: Horizontal track filled with accent-gradient-usage, labeled at both ends (e.g. 'Design' / 'Development'), small circular handle/dot marking current position

breakpoints.mobile: < 480px — single column, the two mobile screenshots ARE this breakpoint's default and scrolled states
breakpoints.tablet: 480–1024px — not shown in source; recommended: collapse desktop's 3-column layout to 2 columns (sidebar collapses to icon-only rail or a top bar; right rail content moves below center content)
breakpoints.desktop: > 1024px — the 3-column dashboard layout shown in the 4th screenshot

rules: Below 1024px, convert the left sidebar into either a top app bar with a hamburger/drawer, or an icon-only rail (labels hidden, tooltips on hover)
Below 1024px, the right rail (Skills, Quick Links) stacks beneath the center content rather than sitting beside it
Stat/info rows that show 4 items in a row on desktop reflow to a 2x2 grid on tablet and a horizontally scrollable row (matching the mobile StatChip pattern) on mobile
The hero illustration (desk/workstation graphic) is desktop-only chrome — hide it below tablet to conserve space rather than shrinking it further
LinkTile grids stay 2-column down to mobile; below ~360px width they may stack to 1 column
All corner radii, spacing tokens and font sizes stay constant across breakpoints (this system does not scale down radii/spacing for mobile — it reflows layout, not density)
The glass/blur background treatment and ambient gradient glow should persist at every breakpoint for visual consistency

motion.principles: Subtle, soft, never abrupt. Favor ease-out for entrances, ease-in-out for state toggles.

patterns.cardEntrance: fade + slight upward translate (8-12px), 250-300ms ease-out, staggered ~40ms per item in a grid/list
patterns.tileTap: scale down to 0.97 on press, spring back on release
patterns.carouselDots: opacity/scale transition 150ms on active dot change

doList: Always wrap content in a translucent, blurred, rounded-corner (24-32px) panel over a dark gradient-glow background — never a flat white or flat solid-dark background with sharp cards
Keep exactly one accent hue (amber) as the dominant highlight color; use violet only as a secondary gradient partner, never as a standalone primary
Use rounded-square avatar/icon frames consistently instead of circles
Pair every numeric stat with a small caption label directly beneath it
Give every external/social link its own tile with a small 'external link' glyph in the corner
Keep typography rounded/friendly for names and headings; utilitarian/system sans is fine for dense dashboard data
Reflow, don't shrink: adapt layouts across breakpoints by changing column count and stacking order, not by scaling down the radius/spacing/type scale
avoidList: Circular avatars (this system standardizes on rounded-squares)
Hard, high-contrast drop shadows (keep shadows soft/diffuse)
Mixing more than two accent hues at full saturation simultaneously
